lead: One line that says who you are and what you do.

blocks.body:
Write this page like the opening of a cover letter. Say what kind of role you are applying for, and what kinds of work you have done.

Then say what your work is about. One specific sentence is worth more than a list of adjectives.

blocks.heading: What I bring
blocks.body: How you work on a team. Give one real example that shows it, from school, a job or anywhere else.

blocks.heading: What I’m looking for
blocks.body: The kind of role and team you want, the work that interests you most, when you are available and where you can work.

blocks.heading: Outside the studio
blocks.body: One or two sentences about life outside design. This is the only place for it, so keep it short.
